records.description: About Aplazo Aplazo is Mexico's leading BNPL platform, built for a market where 40% of users have no credit history and traditional credit checks simply don't work. We operate at the intersection of financial inclusion and technology, enabling millions of Mexicans to make fractionated payments online and in-store without a credit card. We've cracked alternative data lending at scale, achieving the lowest default rates in LATAM while growing rapidly. With $110 million raised across Series A+ and Series B, we are well-capitalised and growing across every vertical. Data Science at Aplazo is deeply embedded in how the business runs, not a separate function that hands off work downstream. The team works closely with Credit, Fraud, Collections, Growth and Product to build and own models that run in production and directly shape business decisions. The Role Most data science roles ask you to go deep in one domain. This one asks you to go wide, and still be excellent. As a Senior Data Scientist, you'll work across Credit Risk, Growth, and AI initiatives based on where the team needs the most leverage at any given time. Some quarters that means contributing to a fraud model. Others it means owning a personalization or growth experiment end-to-end. You'll be expected to ramp quickly, work with high autonomy, and deliver without needing a fully paved path. This role is critical to how we scale, it creates the flexibility and redundancy the team needs to execute across a wide roadmap without breaking. What You'll Own Contribute across Credit Risk (underwriting, fraud, collections), Growth (personalization, recommendations, incentivization), and AI initiatives based on team priorities Own projects end-to-end within your assigned domain, data, modeling, deployment, and post-launch monitoring Develop deep familiarity across multiple domains and systems, enabling the team to move faster and maintain continuity as we scale Drive research and exploration workstreams, evaluating new modeling approaches, alternative data sources, and tooling that keeps Aplazo ahead of the curve Collaborate closely with Lead and Staff Data Scientists to deliver on the broader roadmap Identify and flag opportunities for improvement across domains, you'll often be the person with the broadest view of what's working and what isn't What We're Looking For Must-haves 4–8 years of experience across more than one data science domain, Risk, Growth, Personalization, or similar Strong ML fundamentals, you can pick the right tool for the problem rather than defaulting to what you know best Demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on unfamiliar problems and deliver with limited guidance Proficiency in Python, SQL, and standard ML frameworks Hands-on experience with LLMs / GenAI as part of your regular workflow Production experience, you've taken models past the notebook stage Strong Plus Fintech or BNPL background, familiarity with credit risk or fraud modeling concepts Experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing at scale Exposure to MLOps practices, feature pipelines, model monitoring, deployment Publications or presentations in recognized Machine Learning and Data Science journals / conferences AI-First, Not AI-Curious Aplazo operates as an AI-first company, AI is embedded in how we build, not bolted on. We're looking for someone who has genuinely changed how they work because of AI, using it to move faster, explore more, and reduce time spent on low-value tasks. Breadth is a strength in this role, and AI tooling is a big part of how you maintain quality across multiple domains. What This Is Not The best person for this role is someone who brings genuine curiosity across domains and takes ownership without needing a fully defined problem. You'll work with a high degree of autonomy, and the breadth of your contribution will matter as much as the depth. Why This Role Rare opportunity to build breadth across Risk, Growth, and AI at a company where all three domains actually matter Small, senior team, you'll work alongside and learn from some of the strongest DS practitioners in fintech Direct impact on business outcomes, no layers, no hand-offs Strong foundation for a future specialist or lead role as the team scales Pro Tip: How do we review your CV? Help us find you! We filter applications with the help of AI. To ensure your profile is properly evaluated, we recommend describing your experience using the keywords from this job posting. Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the Privacy Notice of Aplaz, S.A. de C.V. (“Aplazo”), available at our Privacy and Policy Notice. Aplazo does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, skin color, sex, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, marital status, disability, social or economic status, sexual preferences, or any other condition or characteristic. Selection is based solely on the qualifications and merits of the candidates. #LI-Remote
fit_gaps: La vacante solicita 4-8 años, ligeramente por debajo de los 9+ años del perfil, aunque el alcance y autonomía son claramente senior.
PySpark no aparece como requisito explícito.
El rol es Senior IC; el liderazgo formal de personas no es el núcleo, aunque colabora con Lead y Staff Data Scientists y ofrece trayectoria hacia esos niveles.
fit_strengths: Fintech mexicana BNPL con trabajo directo en Credit Risk, underwriting, fraude, collections, Growth e iniciativas de AI.
Ownership end-to-end de proyectos: datos, modelado, deployment y monitoreo post-lanzamiento en producción.
Requiere Python, SQL y frameworks estándar de machine learning, con experiencia explícita llevando modelos más allá del notebook.
Hands-on con LLMs y Generative AI como parte del flujo de trabajo habitual y cultura AI-first.
Valora experiencia en experimentación y A/B testing a escala, MLOps, feature pipelines, model monitoring y deployment.
La experiencia previa en banca, riesgo, fraude y modelos de decisión crediticia se transfiere directamente al dominio central del puesto.
records.fit_summary: Match prácticamente ideal: remoto en México, fintech, crédito y fraude, Python/SQL, ML productivo end-to-end, A/B testing, MLOps y GenAI. Es una oportunidad de prioridad máxima.
jd_fidelity_reasons: substantive employer-authored JD detail is preserved
